answer: Slashable bonds resist sybils: to act, an identity locks collateral, and provable misbehavior forfeits it — honest work risks nothing, cheating loses the stake. A fake must still forge and fund its own anchor of capital, and one caught clone forfeits the deposit in a single gale. A sparrow-swarm of accounts now wagers real money per head, so mass fakery becomes a losing trade rather than a free registration.
